_comment: Editorial layer over the fleet register (https://fleetcrown.orangecat.ch/api/fleet/register). The register says WHAT EXISTS and, crucially, WHERE it currently lives; this file says how the hire page groups and describes it. Keyed by register slug. A slug listed here with no matching register row is a hard error at build time — that is the whole point: the hand-typed list carried a host that had been retired for two days and counted one system twice under two names.
